reasons.claim: The two heads are joined by «جميعا» at Abu Mu'awiya, one level of co-transmitters.
reasons.quote: وأبو كريب جميعا عن أبي معاوية

reasons.claim: The dashed aside only restates Abu Kurayb's wording of the same route and adds no link.
reasons.quote: - قال أبو كريب حدثنا أبو معاوية، -

reasons.claim: The chain ends at Abu Hurayra quoting the Prophet, who is not a link.
reasons.quote: عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله

reasons.claim: The chain is three links ending at the Imam who speaks.
reasons.quote: رَوَى عَاصِمُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ

reasons.claim: The exchange between the Prophet and Ali is told inside the Imam's saying and adds no link.
reasons.quote: بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ

reviews.question: al-Faqih's statement of the compiler's routes («طرق») to a source, with no saying (unruled)

reasons.claim: The first route runs through the compiler's father to al-Thaqafi.
reasons.quote: فقد رويته عن أبي- رضي اللّه عنه- عن عبد اللّه بن الحسين المؤدّب

reasons.claim: A second «و رويته» opens a separate route with its own names, so two groups with no shared tail are right.
reasons.quote: و رويته عن محمّد بن الحسن

reasons.claim: If the owner rules such route statements are not stored as chains, the decision would become no_chain; the structure itself is read correctly.
reasons.quote: و ما كان فيه عن إبراهيم بن محمّد الثقفيّ

reviews.uncertainty_note: The structure is right, but whether this route statement is stored as a chain is unruled.

reasons.claim: Hisham narrates from «عنه», a back reference whose antecedent is not in this packet, so it stays a back_reference.
reasons.quote: وَ رَوَى هِشَامُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ عَنْهُ

reasons.claim: No speaker is named in the saying, so no further link can be added.
reasons.quote: أَنَّهُ قَالَ: فِي قَوْلِ اَللَّهِ

reviews.uncertainty_note: No previous report is supplied, so the inherited link cannot be resolved here.

reviews.question: the Prophet speaking a one-sentence report with no transmitter (unruled)

reasons.claim: The report is the bare saying with no transmitter or speaker named before it.
reasons.quote: لَوْ بَغَى جَبَلٌ عَلَى جَبَلٍ

reasons.claim: Qays and Mansur are co-transmitters at one level.
reasons.quote: حدثنا قيس بن الربيع ومنصور بن أبي الاسود، عن الاعمش

reasons.claim: The date is not part of the name.
reasons.quote: الازدي سنة ست عشرة ومائتين

reasons.claim: Ali, quoted by 'Abbad, is the last link; the unnamed asker «قيل» is not a link.
reasons.quote: عن عباد بن عبد الله، قال: قال علي (عليه السلام)

reasons.claim: «قالا» joins the two heads at Abu Mu'awiya.
reasons.quote: وأبو كريب قالا حدثنا أبو معاوية

reasons.claim: Asim asks Anas and Anas answers, so Anas is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن أنس، قال سألته عن القنوت

reasons.claim: «باسناد رفعه» is a gap between Ibn al-Walid and al-Mufaddal, an unnamed link.
reasons.quote: باسناد رفعه قال: حدثنا المفضّل

reasons.claim: The Imam heard speaking is the last link.
reasons.quote: سمعت أبا عبد اللّه عليه السلام يقول

reasons.claim: The Imam is named as speaker with no transmitter before him, a single-link route after the compiler.
reasons.quote: وَ قَالَ اَلصَّادِقُ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ

reasons.claim: The chain runs to 'Umara and his unnamed uncle, a relation link.
reasons.quote: عن عمارة بن خزيمة، أن عمه، حدثه

reasons.claim: The gloss on Yahya is not part of the name.
reasons.quote: يحيى، - وهو ابن حمزة -

reasons.claim: Khuzayma speaks only as a participant in the told story, not as a source of the report, so he is no link.
reasons.quote: قال خزيمة بن ثابت أنا أشهد
